title: Most Expensive Films Ever Made
subtitle: The biggest movie production budgets in history, ranked by nominal cost and replayed across two decades of blockbuster escalation.

cityPreview.summary: The most expensive films ever made, ranked by nominal production budget (what they cost to make, not what they earned).

methodology: The adapter fetches Wikipedia's "List of most expensive films" page, reads the nominal (non-inflation-adjusted) most-expensive-films table, and keeps the 56 highest-budget productions. Each film enters the leaderboard in its release year and holds its reported budget, so the standing for any year is every listed film released by then ranked by budget. Historical frames are reconstructed from release years in the same table, requiring no additional source.
